examples.text: Ik moet me nog even <w>verkleden</w> voordat we naar het restaurant gaan.

target_lang_translations.en: I still need to <w>change</w> before we go to the restaurant.
target_lang_translations.it: Devo ancora <w>cambiarmi</w> un attimo prima di andare al ristorante.

examples.text: Na het sporten gaat hij zich altijd direct <w>verkleden</w> in de kleedkamer.

target_lang_translations.en: After exercising, he always goes to <w>change clothes</w> immediately in the locker room.
target_lang_translations.it: Dopo lo sport va sempre subito a <w>cambiarsi</w> nello spogliatoio.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to switch from one set of clothes to another

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: sostituire i propri vestiti con altri

senses.sense_definition: zich vermommen door een kostuum of andere kleren aan te trekken voor een feest of toneel

examples.text: Tijdens carnaval gaan veel mensen zich als piraat of superheld <w>verkleden</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: During Carnival, many people <w>dress up</w> as a pirate or superhero.
target_lang_translations.it: Durante il carnevale molte persone si <w>mascherano</w> da pirata o da supereroe.

examples.text: De kinderen wilden zich als spoken <w>verkleden</w> voor het Halloweenfeest.

target_lang_translations.en: The children wanted to <w>dress up</w> as ghosts for the Halloween party.
target_lang_translations.it: I bambini volevano <w>travestirsi</w> da fantasmi per la festa di Halloween.

target_lang_definitions.en: To disguise oneself by putting on a costume or other clothes for a party or play
target_lang_definitions.it: Mascherarsi indossando un costume o abiti particolari per una festa o una recita

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to wear a costume or fancy dress
to change appearance to hide identity

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: mettersi un costume di carnevale o per una festa

senses.sense_definition: de kleren van iemand anders of een pop verwisselen

examples.text: Het meisje was de hele middag druk bezig met haar pop <w>verkleden</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The girl was busy all afternoon <w>changing</w> her doll's clothes.
target_lang_translations.it: La bambina è stata occupata tutto il pomeriggio a <w>cambiare i vestiti</w> alla sua bambola.

examples.text: De moeder moet de baby <w>verkleden</w> omdat zijn kleren nat zijn geworden.

target_lang_translations.en: The mother has to <w>change</w> the baby because his clothes got wet.
target_lang_translations.it: La madre deve <w>cambiare</w> il bambino perché i suoi vestiti si sono bagnati.

target_lang_definitions.en: To change the clothes of someone else or a doll
target_lang_definitions.it: Cambiare i vestiti a qualcun altro o a una bambola

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to replace someone's clothes, like a baby or doll
to put a costume on someone else or a doll

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: mettere vestiti puliti o diversi a un bambino o bambola
